rules: Count only actual invocations. Access blocked by preview is still represented in frontend denominator.
relieve runs before later capacity/missqueue/WAD/landing gates: detach_success does not imply triggering request acceptance.
Correlate frontend/commit with bounded head ticket and counters; never invent same-cycle equality between their different denominators.
Owner conflict, merge path, directory or promotion early return are separately accounted.
Nonzero can_detach with actual commit must reconcile selected candidate, real detach result, and post-relief status; unexplained discrepancy fails diagnostic qualification.

coverage.early_gates: Report observed-head count and unobservable/skipped stages with explicit reason/NA. A frontend observation never claims all traffic/all cycles. Include native requesters: a native requester can require an RO victim.
coverage.kernel: Bind kernel attribution to requesting operation; candidate owner kernel may differ. Emit unassigned/between-kernel bucket if no unique mapping; never force zero. Use GPU physical clock, not Tag memcpy timestamps.
coverage.kernel_overlap: Existing kernel interval deltas may overlap. Do not sum overlapping intervals as causal per-kernel totals; use exact requesterUID only when already available, otherwise INTERVAL_SCOPE/UNKNOWN. Global/per-slice rollups remain mandatory.
coverage.primary_point: Once per actual frontend head at physical GPU cycle, before preview masks the raw Tag probe; key=(slice,physical_cycle,request_uid). Repeated const preview/can_detach/probe calls do not increment totals.
coverage.unique_requests: Head-cycle counts are exposures, not unique requests. Unique episodes may use bounded existing head episode tracking with documented continuity. Do not allocate unbounded UID/address maps.

frontend_funnel.meaning: Raw result before detachable() converts fail to miss. Preserve canonical tag_array::probe semantics; do not infer capacity pressure from aggregate final status.
Mutually exclusive first-failure way categories plus joint predicate bitmask among live candidates. Scan only same physical set. Selection/order remains original first eligible.

Keep raw pressure independent of preview rewrite. Multireason resource masks are nonexclusive; additionally output first blocking gate partition at exact program order. Unsupported observation remains NA, not0.

identities: observed_heads = probe_skipped + raw_hit + raw_hit_reserved + raw_sector_miss + raw_miss + raw_reservation_fail (include any exact existing enum as separate bucket)
eligible_observed_pressure = pressure_no_live_ro + pressure_live_ro_no_eligible + pressure_eligible, with explicit excluded/T-off scope
At full same-set candidate scans: sum(exclusive_way_reasons) = actual_ways_examined; early stop scans record examined/not_examined, never pretend full scan.
detach_calls = detach_success + detach_false + detach_exception (terminal valid runs require exceptions0)
sum(existing detached across slices)=sum(new detach_success across slices) on successful full run
Rollups equal sum(per kernel/slice plus explicit unattributed buckets); no dropped residual.

raw_pressure_production_probe_reached = pressure_preview_relief_rewritten_to_miss + pressure_preview_kept_tag_fail + pressure_relief_not_consulted, all at explicit intermediate pre-resource-status stage.
rewritten_to_miss is not finaladmission; latercapacity/WAD failure remains in separate gate and finalstatus fields.

rules: reuse_seen is sticky; do not clear on waiter retirement.
Retain existing real counter detached as authoritative and reconcile new success total.
A transaction may retire without detach. Response is requester-count, retirement is transaction-count: do not set them equal.
Conservation equations must handle split sectors, multiple requesters, pending terminal state and initial/final populations explicitly.

native_preview_caveat: Native/non-RO preview can reject all-reserved pressure without consulting detachable, even if pure same-set shadow finds a legalRO victim. Record relief_preview_not_consulted and requester_class separately. Do not modify this path to manufacture activation; theoretical ft_access relief support is not proof frontend can reach it.
observer_invariance: Do not change reuse policy, predicate, set mapping, way order, cache geometry, ports, timing, resource quotas, MSHR lookup or certificate semantics.
Never call mutating query_admissible/frontend issue/reservation to gather observations. No extra paid Tag/TVD/oracle lookup or response selection.

Prefer capturing existing raw probe and pure transaction predicate snapshot. A shadow read-only same-set inspection may be used only outside modeled decisions, with bounded host cost, no extra modeled accesses and explicit A2 review.
No counters inside repeatedly evaluated const preview/can_detach functions. Thread observation context or use explicit real frontend hook.
Do not alter detach handshake, delayed response or rollback to force positive result. Counter overflow fails or saturates with explicit overflow-invalid marker, never silent wrap.

output.bounded_examples: At most64 total samples/run, fixed-size ring, no new full trace, no raw data/UID map dump
output.per_set: Bounded pressure/candidate histograms and hotspot examples; do not emit dense cycle-by-set trace
output.terminal: All64slice records, coverage/overflow/dropped-sample flags, counts and closure status; absent metrics UNKNOWN notzero
output.version: distinct EPL2DETACH_DIAG_V1 records, old parser ignores or new parser handles explicitly
